title: Installing a 5 Speed Lenco and Twin Turbos On Our 7.3L Godzilla Swapped Mustang
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-17:09). 0:00-0:55 is a sponsor read.

notes.fact: Rushed build for Sick Week (caption also says 'SEMA week', likely garble)
MassFab sent a wing for Ruby (mention only)

cars.build_version: McFlurry - Godzilla 7.3 twin turbo, Lenco (Sick Week rush build)
cars.owner_driver: Cleetus McFarland team (Ty fab, Sam machining, James lines, Zack wiring)

engine.notes: fitting required remade crossmember section to clear oil pan; half K-member, custom motor/trans mounts

power_adder.kit: quick 'one day' MIG-welded Ty turbo kit; uses Leroy's old 'bull horns' pieces; Motion Raceworks 'butt cheek' Y kit for the merge
power_adder.intercooler: none (crew vote to skip; saves ~5 h fab)

fuel.plan: VP C16 race fuel because no intercooler; joked about injectors in charge pipe

transmission.type: Lenco 5-speed (title) with Bruno drive; lever shifters with custom throw

chassis.cage: certified cage; one tube trimmed for shifter clearance
chassis.seat: new seat; seating/carpet brought over from TBM

electrical.fact: fuel pump, level sender, switch panel with breakers; big fuel tank

risks_stated.fact: No intercooler -> hot intake air; crew expects possible head gasket/piston damage, packing spares

parts.part: Motion Raceworks twin-turbo Y ('butt cheek') kit
Unidentified used part called 'garbage' (price garbled/cut off)
